description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the UserEntity class within the OAuth DTO entity package of the OrangeHRM project. It tests the creation of a UserEntity from a User entity object.

classes.name: UserEntityTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the UserEntity data transfer object creation from a User entity.
